plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Volius Communications optical transmission equipment (amplifiers, receivers, optical switches and transmitters; PEN 34652). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects case temperature, fan speed and per-rail supply voltage (actual and nominal) from the common system-general group.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Volius case temperature in degrees Celsius from vlsCaseTemperature (VlsDeciCelsius). The collector divides the raw 0.1 ℃ reading by 10. Values outside −40..125 ℃ are dropped.

metrics.name: volius_fan_speed
metrics.description: Volius fan rotation speed in RPM from vlsFanSpeed (VlsRPM). Values below 0 or above 30000 RPM are dropped. The object is present on OA/OT products and omitted on OR/OS.

metrics.name: volius_supply_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Actual Volius supply-rail voltage in volts from vlsSupplyVoltageActual (VlsMillivolt). The collector divides the raw millivolt reading by 1000. Sentinel values and |raw| > 100000 are dropped.

metrics.name: volius_supply_nominal_volts
metrics.description: Nominal Volius supply-rail voltage in volts from vlsSupplyVoltageNominal (VlsMillivolt). The collector divides the raw millivolt reading by 1000. Sentinel values and |raw| > 100000 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Volius transmission device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
